alias: Cameras - engine log archive not archiving
description: Two consecutive failed runs of the hourly engine-log archive (sensor.camera_engine_log_archive): error (nothing written), unknown (HA's command_timeout passed - HA 2026.9.4 publishes unknown with attributes {} and does NOT kill the process), busy (the previous run still holds the lock) or clock (no new engine line for 48 h+: the engine is stopped or hung, its log no longer reaches the journal, or the clock jumped; retention is suspended). Run k sets its state at most 3600 + 600 s after run k-1, so a failure held 75 min has been confirmed by the next run. The hold lives in binary_sensor.camera_log_archive_down (delay_on 75 min), which restores across a restart and starts from its first render, so a failure already present when this automation attaches still pages, and error -> unknown does not restart it. One push on the off->on edge (the journal holds ~37 h, the deadline for a fix; a card alone can sit unseen past it); boot and the hourly :43 re-assert restore the card only.
